# VRM AI Technology

VRM AI Technology provides AI, machine learning, and automation platform solutions including [AI Consulting](/solutions/ai-consulting-services), [AI Development](/solutions/ai-development-services), [AI Chatbots](/solutions/ai-chatbot-development), and specialized products like [Workflow.AI](/products/workflow/xpress-screening), [AI Buddy](/products/aibuddy), [People Connect](/products/people-connect), [Exit Intelligence](/products/exitinterview), [Lead Connect](/products/whatsapp), and [Visionix AI](/products/visionix).
